tools.name: premises_licence_info
tools.description: Free service-overview tool for prices, supported workflow, evidence/freshness boundaries and available decision tools. Use only when the user asks what this MCP can do or how to use it. Do not use it for a licensing decision.

tools.name: list_supported_authorities
tools.description: Free authority-enumeration tool. Use only to list supported local licensing authorities or answer whether a named authority is supported. Do not use it to make the licensing decision.

tools.name: licensing_source_status
tools.description: Free official-evidence health tool. Use for source lifecycle/freshness status globally or for one authority. Do not use it for a licensing decision.

tools.name: source_fingerprint_status
tools.description: Free official-source fingerprint and drift-detection tool. Use when the Agent asks whether an official source changed or still matches the reviewed baseline. Do not treat changed or unresolved evidence as current.

tools.name: premises_licence_preflight
tools.description: PAID x402 decision tool for ONE supported local authority ($0.03 USDC by current production default). Use when the user wants a deterministic answer about Licensing Act 2003 triggers, authority-specific policy risks, missing facts and next actions before submission. Prefer this over free discovery/r

tools.name: compare_licensing_requirements
tools.description: PAID x402 comparison tool for TWO OR MORE supported local authorities ($0.05 USDC by current production default). Use when the same premises/business facts must be evaluated across authorities before choosing a location or licensing strategy. Do not use it for a single-authority decision.

tools.name: local_policy_capabilities
tools.description: Free one-authority capability tool. Use when the local licensing authority is known and the Agent needs encoded local-policy dimensions or facts worth collecting. Do not use it for the final licensing decision.

tools.name: preflight_readiness
tools.description: Free missing-input/readiness tool for a known premises-licence scenario. Use it to identify facts still missing before spending on a paid preflight. Do not use it to determine the licensing outcome.
